result.title: Approval Note — Heat Exchanger E-201
result.body:
Equipment
E-201; report reference: IR-E201-2026-08-20

Findings
Rows 12–15 measured 3.8–4.2 mm against the minimum allowable 4.6 mm.

Recommendation
Conditional clearance pending retubing of the affected tubes. [SOP-114 §3.2]

citations.label: SOP-114 §3.2
citations.supportingExcerpt: When a report identifies a tube-wall measurement below the minimum allowable value, localised pitting, or gasket degradation, the approval note must list each finding and its evidence. Conditional clearance may be recorded only when the affected tubes are scheduled for retubing and any recommended gasket replacement is recorded. The approval note must cite this section as [SOP-114 §3.2].

missingInformation.note: No approving authority is stated in the supplied inspection report.
